seo.title: Privacy Policy — Jobsite Systems
seo.description: How jobsite.systems collects, uses, and protects information when you submit an inquiry or visit the site.

header.heading: Privacy Policy
header.lead: What the site collects, why, and how it's handled. No dark patterns, no selling of data.

body.heading: 1. What this policy covers
paragraphs: This policy describes what information jobsite.systems collects when you visit the site or submit the contact form, how it's used, and your rights regarding that information.

body.heading: 2. Information collected
paragraphs: Two categories of data are collected:
items: Inquiry form submissions — name, email, business name, project type, service area, message, and your acknowledgment of these terms.
Anonymized site analytics — aggregate visit data (page views, referrer, country). No cookies, no personal identifiers, no cross-site tracking.

body.heading: 3. How information is used
paragraphs: Information you submit is used only to:
items: Respond to your inquiry and evaluate fit for a potential engagement.
Follow up about a potential or active project.
Aggregate analytics to improve the site.

body.heading: 4. What your information is never used for
paragraphs: Your information is never sold, never shared with advertisers, and never used for mass marketing. There are no lead-gen email sequences or drip campaigns.

body.heading: 5. Service providers
paragraphs: A few third-party services are involved in operating the site:
items: Cloudflare Workers — receives the form submission, validates it, and hands it to the email provider. Nothing is stored; the request is only in memory for the duration of the POST.
Emailit — transactional email delivery for form submissions. Their privacy policy governs that hand-off.
Standard business email — used to store and respond to messages from the contact form.

body.heading: 6. Retention
paragraphs: Inquiry emails are retained in our inbox and archive as long as they're useful for business records or an ongoing client relationship. You can request deletion at any time.

body.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal information related to your inquiry. Email hello@jobsite.systems and we will action the request within a reasonable timeframe.

body.heading: 8. Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: This site does not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising pixels. Local storage is used only for minor site preferences.

body.heading: 9. Security
paragraphs: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are in place to protect submitted information, but no online transmission or storage is 100% secure.

body.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: This site is not directed at children under 13, and no information is knowingly collected from them.

body.heading: 11. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may be updated occasionally. The "last updated" date at the top reflects the most recent revision.

body.heading: 12. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or data requests, email hello@jobsite.systems.
